text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it conflicts with City Policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is recommending that overnight on-street permit parking be introduced on Gilpin Avenue, between Keele Street and Bicknell Avenue from 12:01 a.m. to 7:00 a.m., on a street name basis. Residents requested the implementation of overnight on-street permit parking on Gilpin Avenue to accommodate their long-term parking needs.

The Etobicoke Community Council: 1. Authorized parking by permit only, on a street name basis, to be in effect from 12:01 a.m. to 7:00 a.m. daily on the even side of Gilpin Avenue, from Keele Street to Bicknell Avenue.
